product.title: Big Island: Discover Hilo Helicopter Tour

description.text: On the Big Island, the best way to see Hawaii’s steaming vents and glowing lava has always been like the birds. You’ll get that feeling on this helicopter tour, soaring above one of the most volcanically active islands on the planet. Stops include Hilo, Volcano, Kilauea Volcano. Getting the pilot’s commentary via headphones, you’ll witness waterfalls, craters, the craggy coastline, and—if you're lucky—the volcano’s fiery glow. Ideal for visitors touring Hawaii Volcanoes National Park who want a guided Big Island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
